title: Law-check fixture omits an imported workflow helper
detail: At e079d0c555fde855527a82c7a497a4d07e6e4c04, 9 of 84 cases fail because sandbox() copies design_surfaces.py without its newly imported workflow_extensions.py. The same narrow case passes at producer base fd1caa475f85483cf5c4031a1e58656ff5d3eaff. This is a fresh candidate regression, not a sandbox denial.
fix: Scope decision required before changing the fixture dependency-copy list; message-4 forbids manual product edits.
